verdict.rationale: telli documents its own data retention feature, which automatically deletes contacts and call data once they reach a user-defined age. That directly covers controlling both retention and deletion. The evidence is a single first-party doc line with no further depth. missing for 10: on-demand or manual deletion of specific records (UI or API), retention scope and granularity details (e.g. recordings vs transcripts), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Data retention deletes contacts and call data automatically once they reach an age you define.
